# ataila_ai_gateway (Data Source)

The platform's AI gateway: the OpenAI-compatible base URL clients call with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, and the serving-tier names. **Needs a platform with an AI gateway**: without one the read fails with `gateway_not_configured`, never retried.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Needs a platform with an AI gateway.
data "ataila_ai_gateway" "this" {}

output "openai_base_url" {
  value = data.ataila_ai_gateway.this.base_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `base_url` (String) The base URL (ends in `/v1`).
- `tiers` (List of String) Every serving tier name, sorted.
